summary: Star Bulk Carriers filed a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing notifications received under Greek law 3556/2007 and EU Regulation 596/2014 Article 19(3). Directors, executives and closely associated entities subscribed for newly issued common shares at $24.50 per share on September 15, 2026, including Augustea MED (50,000), Ultima Thule (74,400), Tsiatlino (74,400), and officers Spyrou (15,000) and Begleris (13,750). This is an ordinary insider/PDMR disclosure of an equity issuance, not a special situation; watch for aggregate capital raised and any follow-on placement pricing.
